children: Limoneira CO reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $43.81M and a diluted loss per share of ($0.17), compared with revenue of $47.48M and diluted loss per share of ($0.06) in the prior-year quarter; net loss attributable to the company widened to ($2.99M) from ($855K).
¹ Reported as “Total net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to Limoneira Company”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
Agribusiness revenue declined about 26% year-to-date, driven by lower lemon, avocado and brokerage volumes despite higher per-carton lemon prices.

Limoneira entered a packing and marketing agreement with Sunkist effective Nov. 1, 2025, shifting sales and marketing responsibilities to Sunkist and reducing brokered sales; lemon revenues are expected to peak in Q3–Q4 under the agreement.
The company is accelerating an avocado expansion program targeting an additional 1,000 acres through fiscal 2027 and is ceasing Yuma lemon orchards to monetize Colorado River water rights.

Operational initiatives include formation of an Agromin joint venture to develop an organics recycling facility (site lease signed, targeting operations in H2 FY2027) and marketing the impaired Windfall Farms property with a pending sale.
